meta.source: Protagonist Ink — Website Design System, updated 25 September 2026

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Dominant background and reading field. Paper dominates every page.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on paper (14.10:1). Also the one dark surface on the homepage: the selected work section.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Editorial red. Deliberate emphasis with a consistent job: the primary button, the headline full stop, engagement labels, title fields. 4.85:1 on paper; passes for text. On ink it is 2.91:1: marks only, never text; use red-on-ink for type there.

tokens.name: red-press
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of red buttons and links on paper (6.33:1 with paper text).

tokens.name: red-on-ink
tokens.usage: PROPOSED, not in the approved palette: red tint for text on ink surfaces (4.65:1). Use only where red type must appear on a charcoal field; otherwise set that text in paper.

tokens.name: indigo
tokens.usage: Occasional substantial dark field with paper text (12.94:1). Never red on indigo (2.67:1). On indigo the button is paper with indigo text.

tokens.name: graphite
tokens.usage: Captions and secondary information on paper (5.15:1).

tokens.name: proof
tokens.usage: Optional quiet supporting surface. Quotations and evidence do not need a tinted box by default.

tokens.name: paper-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and captions on ink (5.94:1). Graphite fails on ink; use this instead.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairline rules on paper. Only between meaningful content.

tokens.name: rule-on-ink
tokens.usage: Hairline rules and form field borders on ink. Field borders that must be found also get a label above them.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring, offset 3px, on paper. On ink use paper as the ring.

styles.name: hero
styles.sample: It’s time to write your sequel.
styles.usage: Desktop hero, 72–112px. Ethic Regular, sentence case, intentional line breaks. The approved headline is never reworded.

styles.name: hero-mobile
styles.sample: It’s time to write your sequel.

styles.name: statement
styles.usage: Major editorial statements and section heads carried by the serif (40–64px). Not every heading.

styles.name: excerpt
styles.sample: A line of real copy, set large enough to be read as writing.
styles.usage: Writing excerpts shown as proof of craft. Readable passages, never screenshots.

styles.name: heading-sans
styles.usage: Satoshi headings with authority: work titles, section heads that should read direct rather than literary.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: Narrative strategy, messaging and copywriting for artists, founders and leaders.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Body copy runs 55–70 characters to a line.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Engagement labels and short eyebrows. Capitals only for a word or two.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Captions sit directly under their image; never decorative microtype.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Hairline offsets, icon gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Label to title.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Caption under image; related lines.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Mobile outer margin; paragraph rhythm.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Desktop gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Within a composition: title to body block.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Desktop outer margin.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between compositions inside a section.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Between major ideas (sections). Separate generously, never equal padding everywhere.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Full-bleed photography and fields.

tokens.name: radius-soft
tokens.usage: Form fields, small tags.

tokens.name: radius-frame
tokens.usage: A slight softening for framed surfaces: photographs set within the grid, post covers, case-study artifacts, the How we work tabs. Editorial with a little humanity; never rounder.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons only.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Maximum content width, 12 columns.

tokens.name: columns-desktop
tokens.usage: Desktop grid.

tokens.name: columns-mobile
tokens.usage: Mobile grid, 20–24px margins.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target.
